newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Esso Singapore cuts refinery runs by 20/25-pct.
newsitem.headline: Esso Singapore cuts refinery runs by 20/25-pct.

text.p: Esso Singapore cut runs at its 230,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) refinery by 20/25 percent over the weekend, a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
The spokeswoman said the cuts were being made for an indefinite period. She did not give any reason for the cuts.
Refiners in Singapore said refining profits disappeared last weak as product prices in Singapore plunged.
Shell Singapore was the first refinery to cut runs when it reduced throughputs by 5,000 tonnes per day (30,000-bpd) at its 435,000-bpd refinery on Friday.
